origin.description: With a matching frequency greater than 1, each time prints as year(cycle), counting the cycle inside the year from 1. Otherwise the label is as.character of the value rounded to digits. 0.0001 prints as 1e-04.

arguments.name: frequency
arguments.text: Optional frequency. When the steps are multiples of 1/frequency, labels are year(cycle).

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Decimal places used when the frequency does not apply. The default is 4.
